note: Data for the offline QA plan. The first matching category wins for each changed file. {area} is filled in. Add or change categories here; no code change is needed.

cases.title: {area}: the changed tests still fail when the behaviour is wrong
preconditions: The code under test is at the same revision
steps: Read the changed tests
Check that each assertion would fail if the behaviour broke
expected: Every changed test checks real behaviour, not only that it runs

cases.title: {area}: links, commands and examples in the changed docs are correct
steps: Open each changed document
Follow each link
Run each example command in a test environment
expected: No broken link
Every example works as written

cases.title: {area}: the app still installs and starts with the changed dependencies
preconditions: A clean install in a test environment
steps: Install from the lock file
Start the app
Open the main screens or call the main endpoint
expected: Install succeeds without new warnings you cannot explain
The app starts and the main path works

cases.title: {area}: no new vulnerable or unexpected package
steps: List added and upgraded packages
Check each for known advisories and licence fit
expected: Every new package is expected and acceptable

cases.title: {area}: the build and pipeline still pass
steps: Run the pipeline or the build command in a clean environment
expected: The build passes
Artifacts have the expected names and contents

cases.title: {area}: the app reads the changed setting and behaves as set
preconditions: The old and the new value of the setting
steps: Start with the new value
Exercise the feature that depends on it
Switch back to the old value
expected: The new value takes effect
The old value still works
No secret or address is hard-coded

cases.title: {area}: a missing or invalid setting gives a clear message
steps: Remove the setting
Set it to an invalid value
Start the app
expected: A plain error that names the setting
No crash and no silent default that hides the problem

cases.title: {area}: existing data survives the change
preconditions: A copy of representative data in a test database
steps: Record row counts and sample values
Apply the change or migration
Compare counts and samples
expected: No row is lost or changed by mistake
New columns or fields have sensible defaults

cases.title: {area}: the change can be rolled back or re-run safely
steps: Apply the change twice
Roll it back if a rollback exists
expected: Re-running does no harm
The rollback restores the previous state, or the plan says why there is none

cases.title: {area}: empty, null and very large values
steps: Save empty, null and very long values in the changed fields
expected: Each is stored or rejected with a clear message

cases.title: {area}: the changed screen works end to end
preconditions: The real app running against the test environment
Test data that exercises the screen
steps: Open the screen from the normal navigation
Do the main task the screen is for
Check each changed element
expected: The task completes
Every changed element shows the right words and data

cases.title: {area}: empty, loading, error and very long content
preconditions: Test data with no items, one item and many items
A way to see an error state
steps: Open the screen with no data
Open it with a very long name or value
Cause an error state if you can
expected: No overflow or cut-off text
Empty and error states say what to do next

cases.title: {area}: keyboard and screen-reader basics
steps: Tab through every control
Check that focus is visible
Check that controls have names
expected: Every control can be reached and used with the keyboard
Focus is visible and in a sensible order

cases.title: {area}: layout at the supported window widths and in dark mode
steps: Resize to the narrowest and widest supported widths
Switch to dark mode and back
expected: No sideways overflow
Text stays readable in both themes

cases.title: {area}: a valid request returns the right result
preconditions: The service running against the test environment
steps: Send a valid request that uses the changed code
Read the result back from the source of truth
expected: The response has the expected shape and values
The readback matches the response

cases.title: {area}: invalid, missing and oversized input is refused clearly
preconditions: The service running against the test environment
steps: Send a request with a missing field
Send a wrong type
Send a very large body
expected: A clear error and a sensible status
Nothing is saved for a refused request

cases.title: {area}: permissions and secrets
steps: Call the changed operation without permission
Check logs and responses for secrets
expected: A user without permission is refused
No secret appears in a log or response

cases.title: {area}: known inputs still give the known outputs
preconditions: A set of real or representative inputs with known results
steps: Run each known input through the changed code
Compare with the expected output
expected: Every known input gives the same output as before, unless the change says otherwise

cases.title: {area}: boundary and malformed input
steps: Try empty input
Try the smallest and largest valid values
Try malformed or truncated input
expected: No crash
A clear message or a safe result for each

cases.title: {area}: time and memory on a large input
steps: Run the changed code on the large input and note time and memory
expected: No large slowdown compared with before the change

cases.title: {area}: the changed behaviour works as intended
preconditions: Data that reaches the changed code
steps: Do the user action or call that reaches the changed code
Check the result against what the change says it should do
expected: The result matches the intended behaviour

cases.title: {area}: wrong input or a failing dependency is handled
steps: Give the changed code invalid input
Make a dependency fail or time out if you can
expected: A clear error, no crash, no partial save

cases.title: {area}: the changed files do what the change says
steps: Read the change
Exercise the feature it touches
expected: The feature works as described

requirementCases.title: {area}: the main path works as the requirement says
preconditions: A test environment with representative data
steps: Follow the requirement from start to finish as a user would
Check each result against the requirement text
expected: Each statement in the requirement is true in the running product

requirementCases.title: {area}: wrong or missing input is refused clearly
steps: Leave each required input empty
Give each input a wrong type or an out-of-range value
expected: A plain message says what to fix
Nothing is saved for a refused input

requirementCases.title: {area}: boundaries, empty states and very large values
steps: Try zero items, one item and the largest realistic number of items
Try very long text
expected: No crash, no cut-off text, no wrong total

requirementCases.title: {area}: what worked before still works
steps: Repeat the previous main flows that touch the same data or screens
expected: The previous behaviour is unchanged unless the requirement changes it

regression: The main task of the product still works from start to finish in the test environment
Nothing in the changed area saves, creates, sends or deletes data you did not intend
The app starts, shows no new error, and logs no new warnings you cannot explain
notCovered: This plan was designed from the change and the stored context, without running the product. Nothing here has been executed.
Performance under real load, long-running behaviour and other machines are not covered unless a case says so.
